CECT / Imaging Details

Pre chemo CECT (F+N+T) 24/03/26: ill-defined heterogeneously enhancing ulceroproliferative soft tissue mass lesion centered in the right buccal mucosa, measuring approximately 4.5 cm (AP) × 1.6 cm (TR thickness) × 4.8 cm (CC).
  • Superiorly: Extends up to the superior gingivobuccal sulcus. No evidence of skull base involvement. Pterygoid plates are intact, with no erosion.
  • Inferiorly: Infiltration of the inferior gingivobuccal sulcus and adjacent gingival mucosa.
  • Medially: No evidence of bony erosion or sclerosis. Retromolar trigone is not involved.
  • Laterally: Infiltration of the buccinator muscle with extension into the overlying subcutaneous fat.
  • Anteriorly: The lesion extends up to the level of the right canine tooth.
  • Posteriorly: The lesion remains well away from the masticator space, with no definite involvement.
  • Few enlarged right submandibular and cervical level II lymph nodes, largest approximately 1.1 × 1.4 cm at submandibular level.
  • Few small-volume lymph nodes also seen in the left submandibular and cervical level II regions, largest approximately 6 mm in short axis, indeterminate.
